title: Tomato Red Rice
summary: Fluffy rice toasted in oil, then simmered in a blended tomato, onion and garlic broth. The side dish that goes with every taco night.

creator.bio: Sample creator. Everyday Mexican family cooking: tacos, rice and slow-simmered sauces.

ingredients.name: chicken stock
ingredients.notes: use vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian

steps.instruction: Blend the tomatoes, onion, garlic and salt into a smooth purée.
success_cues: Purée is completely smooth with no chunks

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and add the drained rice. Stir constantly until the grains turn opaque and lightly golden, 4 to 5 minutes.
success_cues: Grains are chalky white with some light golden ones
warnings: Hot oil can spit; add food away from your body and keep the handle turned inward.
steps.creator_note: Toasting the rice is what keeps the grains separate. Take your time.

steps.instruction: Pour in the tomato purée and let it sizzle and thicken for 2 minutes, stirring.
success_cues: Purée darkens slightly and most of the raw tomato smell is gone
warnings: The purée will spit when it hits the hot rice; pour it in slowly.

steps.instruction: Add the stock, bring to a boil, then cover, turn the heat to low and cook 18 minutes without lifting the lid.
success_cues: Small steam holes dot the surface of the rice

steps.instruction: Rest off the heat, still covered, for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and fold in cilantro if using.
success_cues: Grains are tender and separate, not mushy
warnings: Lift the lid away from you; trapped steam is hot.

creator_notes: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear; that also helps keep it fluffy.
dietary_warnings: Check the stock label; some contain wheat, soy or celery.
